title: EspressoLab grinder spec
description: Input to `espressolab_cli grind`: burr geometry and breakage behaviour. Outside the shot pipeline -- this document never reaches the solver and cannot affect a shot's result hash.
$comment: Kept synchronized with engine/grind/grinder_io.cpp's load_spec_json() (structure) and GrinderSpec::validate() (ranges and the cross-field rules noted below, which this schema cannot express structurally). Every field is optional: the loader defaults each to the compiled-in GrinderSpec value.

burr_gap_um.description: A physical length, not a grinder dial number. Nothing maps a dial onto it. Particles at or below this size have left the grinding zone and are not broken again.

bean_diameter_um.description: Whole-bean feed size. Must exceed burr_gap_um; GrinderSpec::validate() enforces that cross-field rule, not this schema.

passes.description: Applications of the breakage operator; stands in for residence time in the burrs.

selection_rate.description: Breakage propensity at twice the burr gap. Higher for a darker, more brittle roast.

breakage_exponent.description: Broadbent-Callcott exponent. Larger values push progeny toward the top of the available range, i.e. a narrower grind.

fines_yield.description: Mass fraction of each breakage EVENT routed to the cell-wall fines mode. Mass is broken repeatedly, so the cumulative fines fraction lands several times higher than this.

fines_diameter_um.description: Where the cell-wall mode sits. Must be smaller than burr_gap_um; GrinderSpec::validate() enforces that.

bins.description: Logarithmically spaced size classes from fines_diameter_um to bean_diameter_um. Classes carrying no mass are dropped from the output.
